how_to_produce: Collect verified address -> feeder examples across multiple DESCO S&D divisions. 500 is a reasonable initial target; adjust to whatever verified labels can actually be obtained.
Split into development and holdout sets before any tuning.
Score with apps/web/src/confidence.js rankFeeders() against the holdout set.
Record Top-1, Top-2 and Top-3 accuracy, plus utility- and division-level accuracy.
Record error types: boundary ambiguity, incomplete address, overlapping area descriptions, outdated feeder text, geocoding failure.
Only then set thresholds. Do not pick a target number first and tune toward it.
